text_block_list.text:
Just before summer camp comes to an
end...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ehe! ☆ Only for a moment, but yeah!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I call it the Sea Spray ☆ Splitter! And
with that,
I've cleared my original
objective for this summer
camp!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm going at full power! With my new
move, I'm
gonna win and win and keep
on winning!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I better not catch you peeping! ☆ Just
kidding! I
know you wouldn't. ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win and win and keep on
winning.
That's why I'm gonna get
stronger!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Even the president came by to
compliment me.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm doing the right thing... right? So why
do I feel
like...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I just have to focus on winning. As long
as I can
do that... I know my dream will
come true.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
